faqOfficialQ: Is this the official Hacoo website?
faqOfficialA: No. Hacoo VIP is an independent guide. Start at the official Hacoo website for its app and account information.
faqSellQ: Can I place an order here?
faqSellA: This site does not sell, take payments or ship products. Catalog buttons lead to a separate external website. Check the merchant and terms at that destination.
faqSearchA: Search opens an independent external product catalog. It does not search the official Hacoo app or access your account.
faqOrderQ: Who can help with an existing order?
faqOrderA: Use the account and support process of the service where you purchased. Keep the order ID and relevant evidence. This site cannot change orders or approve refunds.
qcCoverText: Compare the identifier, model, selected option and photographs. A similar cover image is not enough to establish an exact match.
qcDetailText: Look for relevant close-ups, seams, materials and included pieces. Record what is visible and what remains unknown.
qcSizeText: Use the chart for the exact listing, confirm units and compare like-for-like dimensions. A photograph alone cannot verify fit or authenticity.
